shortDescription: Retrieves virtual machine info in ESXi without a dependency on the vSphere/ vCenter API.

options.name: filters
options.description: A dictionary of filters.  Only 'hw_name' currently supported.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ESXi server.

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the virtual machine (optional).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to retrieve (optional). Virtual machine names in ESXi are unique This parameter is case sensitive.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of C(username) for the ESXi server, or the password for the private key (if required).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to access the ESXi server at C(hostname).
